#!/bin/bash
set -e
while kill -0 3774891 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
rg -q 'scons: done building targets' artifacts/probability-build.log
export GLOB2_SDL3_PREFIX=/home/bradley/glob2-verify/integrator/sdl3/prefix
scons -j8 release=1 server=0 tests build/linux/client/release/src/glob2 > artifacts/probability-final-build.log 2>&1
python3 test/run_tests.py --update-fixtures --filter 'TurnEngineHarness/the committed*' --filter 'WinProbability/enabled rule*' --no-display --junit artifacts/probability-golden-update.xml > artifacts/probability-golden-update.log 2>&1
git add test/fixtures/multiplayer/FourSquares1.g2mr test/fixtures/multiplayer/FourSquares1.verify-trace.txt test/fixtures/win-probability/rule-trace.txt
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m 'Regenerate optional probability rule records on current simulation'; fi
scons -j8 release=1 server=0 tests build/linux/client/release/src/glob2 > artifacts/probability-final-build.log 2>&1
python3 test/check_sim_revision.py --base origin/master > artifacts/probability-sim-version.log 2>&1
python3 test/run_tests.py -j4 --timeout 1200 --no-display --junit artifacts/probability-full-native.xml > artifacts/probability-full-native.log 2>&1
python3 test/test_cli_smoke.py --binary build/linux/client/release/src/glob2 --artifacts artifacts/probability-cli-placement-final --junit artifacts/probability-cli.xml > artifacts/probability-cli.log 2>&1
python3 test/check_javascript_corpus.py --build-dir build/linux/client/release --output artifacts/probability-js-placement-final > artifacts/probability-javascript-corpus.log 2>&1
env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY=:99 XAUTHORITY=/tmp/xvfb-run.R7Feqe/Xauthority SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER=x11 python3 test/run_tests.py --filter 'CustomGameSetup/custom game screens;*' --filter 'CustomGameSetup/probability statistics*' --junit artifacts/probability-screen.xml > artifacts/probability-screen.log 2>&1
tsan_validation_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
while kill -0 3774937 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
rg -q 'scons: done building targets' artifacts/probability-tsan-build.log
export TSAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1 exitcode=66 second_deadlock_stack=1 suppressions=$PWD/test/tsan.supp"
GLOB2_SIM_THREAD=1 build/probability-tsan/src/glob2 --run-game --map-file "$PWD/maps/balanced.map.gz" --game-seed 7 --player maxima --player cortex --player warrush --player cabino --ticks 600 --replay true --output-dir "$PWD/artifacts/probability-tsan-placement-headless" > artifacts/probability-tsan-headless.log 2>&1
env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY DISPLAY=:99 XAUTHORITY=/tmp/xvfb-run.R7Feqe/Xauthority SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER=x11 SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software SDL_FRAMEBUFFER_ACCELERATION=0 LP_NUM_THREADS=0 GLOB2_USER_DATA_DIR="$PWD/artifacts/probability-tsan-placement-profile" GLOB2_TEST_SEED=5 GLOB2_TEST_MAX_TICKS=300 TSAN_OPTIONS="$TSAN_OPTIONS report_thread_leaks=0" build/probability-tsan/src/glob2 -test-games 1 --map balanced --matchup maxima,cortex,maxima,cortex -G -m -s 1024x768 > artifacts/probability-tsan-windowed.log 2>&1
